# Inactive legacy helper archive

The six original subskills are preserved byte-for-byte as ordinary Markdown,
renamed away from discoverable SKILL.md entry points. They are **not** active
PSI instructions and must not be installed or executed by orientation.

Source of these bytes: this repository at commit
`9a28904`, original `subskills/<name>/SKILL.md` paths. See Git history for the
full commit identifier. The original repository credits /vibe-prd creators;
that credit alone does not establish the exact upstream license or version.

Known candidate upstream from issue #5:
https://github.com/KhazP/vibe-coding-prompt-template

Upstream authorship, exact copied revisions, licenses, notices and modification
history remain **UNVERIFIED**. This change does not assert a license grant,
resolve ownership, or claim infringement. Do not redistribute these as installable
helpers until provenance is resolved by the maintainer. No new license is invented.

Useful research/PRD/design ideas may later become narrowly scoped adapters with
reviewed provenance, version hashes, tool permissions and an explicit contract.
`vibe-workflow` and `vibe-build` must not become peer state owners of PSI.
